payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes binomial coefficients via 2D DP table (Pascal's triangle) dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i-1][j-1]; then multiplies combinations for each color to count valid sequences.
payload.rationale: Solution explicitly builds a 2D DP array for combinations, then uses a loop to multiply these values. The core DP is 2D tabulation, fitting dp_2d_state.
